name: cogeto
description: Verified institutional memory for your documents: verification before storage, contradiction findings, a signed findings report
overridesRationale: multer <=2.1.1 has two DoS advisories (GHSA-72gw-mp4g-v24j, GHSA-3p4h-7m6x-2hcm) reachable via the upload path. It is a transitive dep of @nestjs/platform-express; the patched 2.2.0 line keeps the same API. Pinned here to avoid the breaking drizzle-orm/testcontainers bumps a bare `npm audit fix` would also pull in. uuid <11.1.1 has a buffer bounds advisory (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq); exceljs pins uuid ^8 and npm's only automatic fix is a breaking exceljs DOWNGRADE, so uuid is overridden to the patched line inside exceljs only. exceljs uses uuid's stable v4() API; the XLSX reading suite proves the reader unchanged. deepmerge-ts <8.0.0 has a stack-exhaustion advisory (CVE-2026-40345, GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx); html-to-text (via mailparser) still pins the vulnerable ^7.1.5 and npm's only automatic fix is a breaking mailparser DOWNGRADE, so deepmerge-ts is overridden to the patched 8.x line inside html-to-text only. html-to-text uses it solely to merge its own options object (never message content), and email/email-html-text.spec.ts pins the rendered output across the forced major. Remove once html-to-text ships with deepmerge-ts >=8 (tracked in issue #669).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cogeto/shared && npm run build -w @cogeto/server && npm run build -w @cogeto/web
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && npm run lint:docs && npm run i18n:check
scripts.eval:gate: npm run build -w @cogeto/shared -w @cogeto/server && COGETO_EVAL_GATE=1 node project/src/dist/entrypoints/eval.js
scripts.eval:cached: npm run build -w @cogeto/shared -w @cogeto/server && COGETO_EVAL_CACHE=replay COGETO_EVAL_GATE=1 node project/src/dist/entrypoints/eval.js
scripts.eval:cache:refresh: npm run build -w @cogeto/shared -w @cogeto/server && rm -rf project/eval/cache && COGETO_EVAL_CACHE=record node project/src/dist/entrypoints/eval.js
